purpose: Shadow/future execution packing for semantic CI obligations. Does not itself authorize skipping.

fast-gate.note: Primary installed-dependency lane. Always exists initially because lint remains universal and selected validator/Node groups run here.

deep-verification.note: Expensive implementation/persistence lane. Future scoped CI may skip the whole job when none of these capabilities are selected.

finalStatus.note: Single stable required status. A skipped deep lane is acceptable only because routing decides it was unnecessary; router and fast gate must succeed.
